title: New Hilton Openings in 2027
summary: In 2027, Hilton plans to welcome an exciting collection of new hotels around the globe, debuting new brands in more than 30 countries.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **Hilton plans to welcome an exciting collection of new hotels around the globe, including brand debuts in more than 30 countries.**
- **Brand expansion in key markets include Australia (Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts, LXR Hotels & Resorts, Motto by Hilton), Brazil (Homewood Suites by Hilton), India (Signia Hilton), Malaysia (Curio Collection by Hilton), Maldives (Tapestry Collection by Hilton), Taiwan (Signia Hilton), United States (NoMad) and Vietnam (Conrad Hotels & Resorts)** .
- **Anticipated to open in 2027 are locally inspired lifestyle hotels in cities like New Orleans and Mexico City, new extended-stay options in destinations like Hawaii and Prince Edward Island, and beachfront resorts from Miami Beach to Mykonos.**


In 2027, Hilton plans to welcome an exciting collection of new hotels around the globe, including brand debuts in more than 30 countries, reimaging historic landmarks and introducing distinctive stays in some of the world’s most compelling cities and resort locations.


Highlights include NoMad Detroit, set within the landmark Michigan Central Station; Waldorf Astoria debuts in Tokyo and Sydney; the first Signia Hilton in Asia Pacific; Hilton’s first luxury brand in Vietnam with Conrad Phu Quoc; Homewood Suites by Hilton’s entry into Brazil; Tapestry Collection by Hilton’s first hotel in Maldives; Curio Collection by Hilton's entry into Malaysia; and the Australian debuts of LXR Hotels & Resorts and Motto by Hilton. Travelers can also look forward to locally inspired lifestyle hotels in cities like New Orleans and Mexico City, new extended-stay options in destinations like Hawaii and Prince Edward Island, and beachfront resorts from Miami Beach to Mykonos.


According to[Hilton’s 2027 trends report](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/2027-trends-release) , three in four travelers (76%) agree that having a trip on the calendar gives them a purpose to work toward. With[Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/) , members can earn and redeem Points for memorable stays across Hilton’s growing global portfolio. Whether travelers are seeking a culture-rich city break, a relaxing coastal escape or a hotel with a story rooted in its destination, these are some of the newest Hilton properties to watch in 2027.


**Jump to Region** :


AmericasEurope, the Middle East & AfricaAsia Pacific


## Americas


### [Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/apfsasa-signia-naples-grande-beach-resort/)


**Naples, Florida, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort will usher in a new era for one of Southwest Florida's most iconic beachfront destinations, pairing Signia Hilton's elevated hospitality experience with the natural beauty and relaxed sophistication of Florida's Paradise Coast. Inspired by its extraordinary setting among the mangrove forests of Clam Pass, the newly transformed property will offer a contemporary expression of coastal luxury while remaining true to the destination's timeless appeal.


### [Canopy New York City 34th Street](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nycpypy-canopy-new-york-city-34th-street/)


**New York, New York, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Canopy New York City 34th Street will mark the brand’s debut in New York City. The 365-room, new-build hotel will be in the heart of Midtown, near Madison Square Garden, Penn Station and Moynihan Train Hall, placing guests within walking distance of some of the city’s top attractions and neighborhoods. After a day of exploring, retreat above the city in the hotel’s rooftop lounge or visit the open-air terrace with sweeping skyline views.


### [Chelsea Bogota Parque 93, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/bogchup-chelsea-bogota-parque-93/)


**Bogota, Colombia**


**Anticipated Opening Date** : Q1 2027


Bringing an original boutique stay to Bogota’s Parque 93 neighborhood, this hotel’s story is shaped by modern natural hospitality and a Japandi-inspired design. Chelsea Bogota Parque 93’s identity draws on warm, earthy tones, refined typography and oval geometry, creating a calm, contemporary expression rooted in the Parque 93 setting. Designed to feel distinctive and thoughtfully composed, the property will reflect Tapestry Collection’s focus on independent hotels with original personalities and a strong sense of place.


### [Home2 Suites by Hilton Charlottetown](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/yygapht-home2-suites-charlottetown/)


**Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Canada**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Conveniently situated near Charlottetown Airport and downtown, Home2 Suites by Hilton Charlottetown – the first for the brand in Atlantic Canada - will place travelers within easy reach of the island's top attractions, including Cavendish Beach, Green Gables Heritage Place and the Confederation Centre of the Arts. Guests will be able to settle into spacious suites and enjoy thoughtful amenities such as complimentary build-your-own breakfast, a heated indoor pool, fitness center and flexible event space, creating a comfortable stay for every type of traveler.


### [Home2 Suites by Hilton Nashville near Opryland](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/bnateht-home2-suites-nashville-near-opryland/)


**Nashville, Tennessee, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


At Home2 Suites by Hilton Nashville near Opryland, guests will be just minutes from iconic attractions like the Grand Ole Opry, Opry Mills and the world-renowned Gaylord Opryland Resort & Convention Center as well as Music City’s best entertainment, shopping and dining. After a day of exploring, guests will be able to unwind in a spacious suite featuring an in-room kitchen, take a dip in the heated indoor pool or recharge in the 24-hour fitness center. Plus, pets are always welcome, so every member of the family can join the adventure.


### Homewood Suites by Hilton Florianópolis


**Florianópolis, Santa Catarina, Brazil**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Homewood Suites by Hilton Florianópolis will mark the brand’s first hotel in Brazil as the brand continues to grow its footprint in CALA. The hotel will offer home-like accommodations for guests and their pets traveling for an extended stay or quick overnight trip with the brand’s signature offerings, including residential-style suites with separate living and sleeping areas and a fully equipped kitchen. Guests can enjoy complimentary hot breakfast, including the brand’s signature breakfast tacos, complimentary Welcome Home Wednesday social, onsite laundry, fitness center and other thoughtful amenities to make every stay feel like home.


### [Tempo by Hilton Tucson Uptown](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/tusutpo-tempo-tucson-uptown/)


**Tucson, Arizona, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Tempo by Hilton Tucson Uptown will bring the brand’s thoughtful approach to mindful living to Uptown, an urban resort village featuring shopping, dining and entertainment just north of downtown Tucson. The five-story hotel will feature 144 guest rooms, including rooms with in-room fitness equipment, along with a large outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, onsite restaurant and a bright ballroom with balconies for meetings and celebrations. Through thoughtfully designed spaces and amenities that help guests maintain their routines and find their rhythm, the hotel will offer a balanced home base for exploring nearby golf courses, botanical gardens, Saguaro National Park and other Tucson attractions.


### [Tru by Hilton Punta Cana Dominican Republic](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pujruru-tru-punta-cana-dominican-republic/)


**Punta Cana, Dominican Republic**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Tru by Hilton Punta Cana Dominican Republic will bring the brand’s vibrant, energetic stay experience to one of the Caribbean’s most popular destinations. Located in the Punta Cana Design District, about five minutes from Punta Cana International Airport, the hotel puts guests near restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, including BlueMall Punta Cana. Travelers will enjoy complimentary hot breakfast, free Wi-Fi and parking, a fitness center and Tru’s lively lobby, featuring flexible workspace, a game zone and a 24-hour market.


### NoMad Detroit Michigan Central


**Detroit, Michigan, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Early Spring 2027


Set within the iconic Michigan Central Station in Detroit’s historic Corktown neighborhood,[NoMad Detroit](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/nomad-hotels/) will mark Hilton’s first luxury lifestyle hotel in the United States when it opens as part of the landmark’s ongoing transformation. The 176-room hotel will occupy portions of the station’s historic base and the top five floors of its 15-story tower, offering elegant guest rooms and sophisticated suites within one of the country’s most celebrated Beaux-Arts landmarks. Originally opened in 1913, the station was once the tallest railroad station in the world, and NoMad Detroit will blend the brand’s signature sense of place and artfully lived hospitality with the building’s rich architectural heritage. Inspired by the idea of a great home layered with stories, the hotel will immerse guests in Detroit’s creative energy, with design elements that celebrate local artists and makers throughout the property. The hotel will also feature more than 4,500 square feet of meeting and event space, a signature restaurant, library/lobby bar and lounge, spa, and fitness center, serving as a vibrant gathering place within Michigan Central’s 30-acre innovation district.


### [Motto by Hilton Indianapolis Downtown](https://www.hilton.com/en-gb/hotels/indexua-motto-indianapolis-downtown/)


**Indianapolis, Indiana, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date** : Q2 2027


Motto by Hilton Indianapolis Downtown will bring a neighborhood-inspired hospitality experience to the heart of the city, marking the[brand’s arrival](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/motto-by-hilton/) in Indianapolis. Located within the historic King Cole Building, the 116-room lifestyle hotel will celebrate its legacy as the former home of the renowned Kahn Tailoring Company through thoughtfully integrated design and storytelling. Drawing on the building’s history of made-to-measure craftsmanship, interiors will blend contemporary style with subtle tailoring-inspired details, creating spaces that feel both personal and distinctly local. Embodying Motto’s philosophy of being “plugged into place,” the hotel will connect guests to the energy and culture of downtown Indianapolis through authentic programming, vibrant social experiences and locally driven food and beverage offerings. The property will feature guest rooms that are designed to flex with multi-functional furnishings and seamless technology, as well as Motto’s signature Confirmed Connecting Rooms, allowing guests to connect up to five rooms and customize their stay for both social connection and privacy. Alongside a signature restaurant, lobby café and rooftop bar, Motto by Hilton Indianapolis Downtown will offer active social spaces, a fitness center and curated experiences that encourage guests to immerse themselves in the neighborhood.


### Maison Dupuy New Orleans French Quarter, Curio Collection by Hilton


**New Orleans, Louisiana, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Maison Dupuy New Orleans French Quarter, Curio Collection by Hilton will be Hilton’s first hotel located firmly within New Orleans’ historic French Quarter. The 200-room property sits on the site of the nation’s first cotton press and was created by joining five historic townhouses. Following a comprehensive renovation, the hotel is planned to be transformed into a French Modern retreat that honors the architectural character and cultural spirit of the French Quarter. The property will feature handsome guest rooms, a lush courtyard and swimming pool, lobby “cabaret” lounge, and approximately 9,000 square feet of meeting space, with plans to bring the famed Dominique’s Restaurant & Bistro Bar back to the Quarter.


### Homewood Suites by Hilton Seattle Downtown Lake Union


**Seattle, Washington, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Whether exploring Seattle's vibrant waterfront, taking in the views of Lake Union or visiting for business, Homewood Suites by Hilton Seattle Downtown Lake Union will offer the space and comforts to make every trip feel effortless. Guests will settle into spacious residential-style suites featuring separate living and sleeping areas, plus a fully equipped kitchen perfect for longer stays. The hotel will offer a complimentary hot breakfast, complimentary Welcome Home Wednesday social, and thoughtful amenities like an onsite fitness center, laundry facilities and pet-friendly accommodations.


### Homewood Suites by Hilton Homestead Miami South


**Miami, Florida, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Guests will feel at home while experiencing the best of Miami South at Homewood Suites by Hilton Homestead Miami South. Ideal for both extended stays and weekend getaways, the hotel will offer spacious suites with separate living and sleeping areas and fully equipped kitchens, giving guests the flexibility to travel on their own terms. From complimentary hot breakfast and the brand's signature breakfast tacos to the weekly Welcome Home Wednesday social, every stay is designed to be comfortable, convenient and welcoming for both guests and their pets.


### Home2 Suites by Hilton Knoxville Downtown University


**Knoxville, Tennessee, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Guests looking for accommodations in Knoxville Downtown University will enjoy stylish, flexible suite configurations, home-like amenities and multifunctional community spaces for gathering or work. The hotel will offer spacious suites designed with function and flexibility, an integrated fitness area and laundry room as well as complimentary hot breakfast with the brand’s build your own breakfast sandwiches.


### [Hampton by Hilton Ponce](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/psepohx-hampton-ponce/)


**Ponce, Puerto Rico**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Hampton by Hilton Ponce will offer travelers a welcoming home base near Ponce’s historic district, popular attractions and Mercedita International Airport. Guests can enjoy clean, comfortable rooms, a rooftop terrace, outdoor pool, fitness center and Hampton’s guest-favorite free hot breakfast. With friendly, reliable service throughout the stay, the hotel will bring Hampton’s signature quality, value and hospitality to one of Puerto Rico’s most vibrant destinations.


### [Hampton Inn by Hilton Raleigh Cary Alston Town Center](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/rdugghx-hampton-inn-raleigh-cary-alston-town-center/)


**Cary, North Carolina, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Located near Research Triangle Park with convenient access to Raleigh-Durham International Airport, Hampton Inn by Hilton Raleigh Cary Alston Town Center will provide a comfortable and well-connected stay for business and leisure travelers. The hotel will feature refreshing, comfortable rooms, an indoor pool, fitness center, meeting space and a contemporary lobby bar, complemented by free hot breakfast and the friendly, reliable service guests expect from Hampton.


### [Tempo by Hilton Virginia Beach Town Center](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/orfpopo-tempo-virginia-beach-town-center/)


**Virginia Beach, Virginia, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** First Half of 2027


Tempo by Hilton Virginia Beach Town Center will bring the brand’s thoughtfully designed stay experience to the heart of Virginia Beach’s Central Business District. Located within the evolving Pembroke Square mixed-use destination and near the shopping, dining and entertainment of Town Center, the seven-story, 163-room hotel will feature an urban coastal design, premium guest rooms, a fitness center, inspired meeting spaces, Moonsong Café + Bar — offering breakfast favorites, artisanal smoothies, craft Spirited and Free-Spirited cocktails and small plates — food and beverage offerings and convenient parking. Designed for both business and leisure travelers, the hotel will offer refined yet approachable spaces that help guests maintain their routines, find balance and stay connected to the rhythm of everyday life.


### [Waldorf Astoria Residences Pompano Beach](https://waldorfastoriaresidencespompanobeach.com/)


**Pompano Beach, Florida, USA**


**Anticipated Delivery:** Summer 2027


Developed by Related Group and Merrimac Ventures, Waldorf Astoria Residences Pompano Beach is the first standalone residential development in the portfolio. The 92-residence oceanfront tower recently celebrated its topping-off, with 90% of its units already sold and a record $18.1 million penthouse sale - marking the highest residential transaction in Pompano Beach history. The brand’s arrival to Pompano Beach has helped catalyze the city’s transformation, raising the profile of a once quieter stretch of South Florida’s coastline. The development underscores continued demand for fully standalone residential offerings within the Hilton brand ecosystem.


### Hotel Lexicon Boston, Tapestry Collection by Hilton


**Boston, Massachusetts, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q3 2027


Hotel Lexicon Boston, Tapestry Collection by Hilton will bring an original boutique stay to Beacon Hill, drawing inspiration from Boston’s legacy of writers, artists, educators and reformers who shaped the city’s culture of progress. Designed as a modern expression of the neighborhood’s intellectual and creative spirit, the hotel will invite culturally curious travelers to connect with Boston through refined, locally rooted design, storytelling touchpoints and approachable social spaces.


### Casa di Sirena Campos do Jordão, Curio Collection by Hilton


**Campos do Jordão, Sao Paulo, Brazil**


**Anticipated Opening Date** : Q3 2027


Nestled in the Serra da Mantiqueira mountain range, approximately 100 miles from São Paulo, Casa di Sirena Campos do Jordão, Curio Collection by Hilton will feature 72 guest rooms, each with a private balcony and soaking tub overlooking the surrounding landscape. Set amid native forest with sweeping views of the iconic Pedra do Baú, the hotel will offer an elevated mountain retreat with indoor and outdoor heated pools, a spa, fitness center, tennis and beach tennis courts, and the exclusive Reserva Park, featuring trails, waterfalls and araucaria forest. Guests will also enjoy a variety of inviting gathering spaces, including a fireplace lounge, library and piano bar, alongside two distinctive dining concepts that blend international cuisine with the flavors of the region.


### Jean Hotel Polanco, Curio Collection by Hilton


**Ciudad de Mexico, Mexico**


**Anticipated opening date:** Q3 2027


Jean Hotel Polanco, Curio Collection by Hilton will bring a refined boutique experience to the heart of Mexico City's fashionable Polanco district. Located in vibrant Polanquito, near acclaimed restaurants, luxury shopping and cultural attractions, the 34-room hotel will feature stylish accommodations, personalized service, a signature restaurant, and a rooftop bar, offering travelers an intimate way to experience one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods.


### Graduate by Hilton Laramie


**Laramie, Wyoming, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q3 2027


Graduate by Hilton Laramie will mark the brand’s debut in Wyoming through the conversion of an existing hotel connected to the University of Wyoming Conference Center. Reflecting the University’s Cowboy spirit, the hotel will support conferences, campus programs, and visitors to Laramie and will include the opening of an elevated Western Brassiere restaurant concept, as well as a coffee & cocktail bar. Owned by the Pulte Family Charitable Foundation, the hotel is part of the foundation’s Humanitarian Hotels portfolio, where 100% of net profits are donated to charitable causes locally and around the globe, including financial assistance for UW students. The hotels also undertake philanthropic programming that represents the Foundation’s mission.


### Graduate by Hilton Manhattan KS


**Manhattan, Kansas, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q3 2027


Located right at the entrance of Aggieville and Kansas State University, Graduate by Hilton Manhattan, KS, will mark the brand’s debut in Kansas. The 112-room hotel will be closely tied to the rhythms of campus-adjacent life and downtown activity, and will reflect the character of “The Little Apple,” drawing on Wildcat pride and serving alumni, visitors and locals with spaces that feel distinctly rooted in the community.


### [Hilton Garden Inn Salta](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/slackgi-hilton-garden-inn-salta/)


**San Lorenzo, Salta, Argentina**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q3 2027


Hilton Garden Inn Salta will offer travelers a convenient base to explore the city and the region’s natural surroundings. Located in San Lorenzo Chico, the hotel will be approximately 15 minutes from downtown Salta and the trails of San Lorenzo village, with easy access to Martín Miguel de Güemes International Airport. Guests will enjoy an outdoor pool, fitness center, spa, on-site restaurant, and atrium bar, along with event space for business meetings and celebrations.


### Home2 Suites by Hilton Kihei Maui


**Kihei, Hawaii, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q4 2027


With sunny coastal beaches on Maui’s shore, Kihei continues to attract visitors year after year as a treasured vacation destination. As the first Home2 Suites by Hilton property in Hawaii, this property will welcome guests and their pets to spacious, flexible suites, free hot breakfast every morning and outdoor space to enjoy the local surroundings.


### Waldorf Astoria Miami Beach


**Miami Beach, Florida, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Winter 2027


A landmark refurbishment will transform a premier oceanfront hotel into Waldorf Astoria Miami Beach, bringing the brand’s timeless elegance, intuitive service and signature sense of occasion to one of the world’s most sought-after destinations. Set to debut in Winter 2027, the reimagined resort will feature 348 newly refreshed suites, among the most spacious in the market, each offering ocean views and private balconies, alongside a reimagined arrival experience anchored by Peacock Alley, the brand’s iconic gathering place. Guests will also enjoy a new food and beverage program led by world-class culinary talent, a curated spa and wellness experience with an enhanced fitness center, upgrades to the resort’s expansive 48,000-square-foot pool deck with private cabanas, and revitalized event spaces for celebrations, gatherings and social occasions. Marking Waldorf Astoria’s debut in the Miami Beach market, the hotel will further strengthen Hilton’s growing luxury footprint in Florida.


### Graduate by Hilton Tuscaloosa


**Tuscaloosa, Alabama, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Late 2027


Graduate by Hilton Tuscaloosa will debut in this iconic college town, featuring inspired stays that boast elevated design celebrating Tuscaloosa’s history, local legends and Alabama traditions, alongside reimagined dining, meeting and event spaces. As the only hotel on campus, the property will welcome alumni, students, visitors and locals for game days, commencements and university gatherings.


### [LivSmart Studios](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/livsmart-studios/)


**LivSmart Studios by Hilton continues to drive momentum with several first-in-state openings**


LivSmart Studios by Hilton continues to build momentum as the brand expands into new markets across the country. New openings include **LivSmart Studios by Hilton Cincinnati Sharonville** , marking the brand's debut in Ohio; **LivSmart Studios by Hilton Augusta** , the first location in Georgia; **LivSmart Studios by Hilton Port Allen Baton Rouge** , the brand's first hotel in Louisiana; **LivSmart Studios by Hilton Yuma** , introducing the brand to Arizona; and **LivSmart Studios by Hilton Oklahoma City Bricktown** , the first LivSmart Studios property in Oklahoma. Paired with upcoming openings in established markets, these first-in-state debuts underscore the rapid growth of LivSmart Studios by Hilton and the brand's expanding presence in high-demand markets across the country.


Like all LivSmart Studios hotels, each property offers apartment-style suites with distinct areas to cook, work, and relax, serving as the perfect base for guests seeking the comfort of home with convenience to maintain their normal routines during the long-stay. Guests enjoy a welcoming open lobby, onsite laundry, fitness center, outdoor patio with grills, and complimentary grab and go breakfast.


### [Spark by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/spark-by-hilton/)


**Spark by Hilton continues its rapid global expansion with new openings in sought-after destinations**


Spark by Hilton will continue its rapid global growth in 2027, bringing the brand’s dependable stay experience and accessible value to even more destinations around the world. Upcoming openings include **Spark by Hilton London, Spark by Hilton Las Vegas North, Spark by Hilton Chicago Midway Airport** and **Spark by Hilton Nashik Mumbai Naka** in India, demonstrating the brand’s continued expansion across North America and internationally.


Across the growing portfolio, Spark by Hilton focuses on the essentials travelers value most, including clean and comfortable rooms, friendly service and complimentary breakfast, delivering a consistent stay at an accessible price point backed by Hilton hospitality.


## Europe, the Middle East, and Africa


### [Conrad Corfu](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cfumoci-conrad-corfu/)


**Corfu, Greece**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Spring 2027


Opening on Corfu’s unspoilt southern coast, Conrad Corfu will bring a new expression of Greek island luxury to a secluded 200-metre beachfront. The resort will feature 136 rooms, suites and villas, many with private heated pools or Jacuzzis, alongside the striking Aqua Piazza, a reflective lagoon and social heart of the hotel. Inspired by Corfu’s Venetian and neoclassical heritage, the resort will pair bold contemporary design with landscaped gardens, curated Greek art and panoramic Ionian Sea views. Guests can look forward to three restaurants and two bars, including signature dining by Michelin-starred chef Alexandros Tsiotinis, a destination spa inspired by local botanicals, an open-air cinema and a treehouse-style kids’ club set among olive trees. Just beyond the resort, travellers can explore Corfu's UNESCO-listed Old Town, historic palaces and idyllic Ionian coastline.


### [Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/jmksphi-hilton-mykonos-beach-resort-and-spa/)


**Mykonos, Greece**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Spring 2027


Set against the striking backdrop of Super Paradise Beach, Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa will introduce a sophisticated new resort experience to one of the Mediterranean’s most iconic island destinations. Thoughtfully designed to complement its natural surroundings, the resort will unfold across elegant two-storey buildings inspired by the distinctive character of the Cyclades. The property will feature 67 beautifully appointed guest rooms and suites, each with a private veranda or balcony, while selected accommodations will offer private pools and sweeping views across the Aegean Sea. Positioned as an elevated island retreat shaped by exceptional hospitality, the hotel will offer distinctive dining experiences, thoughtfully curated wellness facilities and inviting spaces for relaxation. With its beachfront setting and effortless connection to the spirit of Mykonos, the resort will provide guests with a refined yet relaxed way to experience the island.


### [Waldhaus Flims Grand Resort & Spa, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/zrhwfqq-waldhaus-flims-grand-resort-and-spa/)


**Flims, Switzerland**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Spring 2027


With a history stretching back to 1877, Waldhaus Flims is set within Switzerland’s largest hotel park, surrounded by the natural beauty of the Flims Forest. The 143-room retreat is the perfect place to explore the Swiss Alps, from more than 235 kilometres of skiing in winter to hiking through the dramatic Rhine Gorge and surrounding mountains in summer. Guests can unwind at the hotel's spa, complete with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas and a natural swimming pond, or stay active in the fitness centre. The resort also offers a variety of dining options and can host a range of events, from board meetings to large gatherings in its ballroom.


### [PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hervhup-phaea-mitato-crete/)


**Crete, Greece**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Spring 2027


Set among the rolling hills above Hersonissos, PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton offers a contemporary Cretan retreat and a more tranquil perspective on the island, conveniently located just a short drive from Heraklion International Airport. Surrounded by olive groves, fragrant gardens and mountain landscapes, the resort offers suites and a villa designed for families, couples and longer stays, alongside swimming pools, wellbeing facilities and inviting spaces for gathering and celebration. Gastronomy is deeply connected to the land, with organic gardens, and local producers bringing seasonal Cretan ingredients and traditions to the table. With direct access to the neighboring Crete Golf Club, and opportunities to discover the island's culture, countryside and local way of life, the property invites travelers to experience a more grounded, meaningful side of Crete.


### [Hilton Lopud Beach Resort & Spa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/dbvoghi-hilton-lopud-beach-resort-and-spa/)


**Lopud, Croatia**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Spring 2027


Hilton Lopud Beach Resort & Spa is a secluded beachfront retreat on Croatia's picturesque Lopud Island, offering a peaceful Adriatic escape just a short ferry ride from Dubrovnik. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and lush Mediterranean landscapes, the resort offers a tranquil escape for travellers seeking both relaxation and discovery. The seasonal resort features 111 modern and comfortable rooms and suites, each with a balcony or terrace, as well as seven spacious apartments in a separate building, each with its own private terrace. Guests can enjoy a range of dining experiences, outdoor pool, spa and wellness facilities with indoor whirlpool, and easy access to local cultural attractions, creating an ideal base for both relaxation and exploration.


## Asia Pacific


### [Signia Hilton Tainan](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/tnnsasa-signia-tainan/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d)


**Tainan, Taiwan**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Signia Hilton Tainan will introduce the first Signia Hilton in Asia Pacific, bringing the brand's signature blend of personalized service and premium experiences to the heart of the city. Inspired by Tainan's renowned culinary scene and growing role as a center of business and commerce, the hotel will serve as a gateway to one of Taiwan's most dynamic destinations.


### [Conrad Bangkok Sukhumvit Queen’s Park](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/bkkqpci-conrad-bangkok-sukhumvit-queens-park/)


**Bangkok, Thailand**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


The 300-room property will be the second Conrad Hotels & Resorts property in the city, complementing the long-established Conrad Bangkok. Located along the bustling Sukhumvit Road and steps away from the luxury EM District, the hotel will feature four dining venues, including a rooftop bar with panoramic views, a spa, a rooftop pool, and a fitness center.


### [Hilton Garden Inn Pattaya City](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/utpgigi-hilton-garden-inn-pattaya-city/)


**Pattaya, Thailand**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q1 2027


Hilton Garden Inn Pattaya City will bring the brand’s approachable upscale hospitality to North Pattaya, offering travelers elevated comforts, polished ease and the familiarity they value while away from home. Guests will be within easy reach of the city’s dining, shopping, entertainment and local attractions, with sweeping rooftop views over Pattaya Bay, an on-site restaurant and bar, outdoor pool and fitness center.


### [Motto by Hilton Shanghai Wuliqiao](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/shamoua-motto-shanghai-wuliqiao/)


**Shanghai, China**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


Motto by Hilton Shanghai Wuliqiao will bring Motto’s social, neighborhood-first energy to Shanghai’s Huangpu District, drawing inspiration from Dapuqiao’s historic Shikumen lilongs, textile heritage and everyday lane life. Conceived as a contemporary “contained Shanghai lane,” the hotel will connect arrival, dining, social spaces and guest rooms through layered materials, woven textures and a relaxed urban rhythm that encourages discovery and connection. From a social living room-style lobby to an informal dining house inspired by local eateries, the property is designed as a flexible launchpad for travelers to plug into the city’s culture, while still delivering Motto’s efficient, smartly designed stay experience.


### The Nautilus, Curio Collection by Hilton


**Langkawi, Malaysia**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027


The 249-room property will be the first Curio Collection by Hilton property in Langkawi. Located within easy access to the Cenang Beach, Langkawi’s main tourist and beachfront area, the hotel will feature three dining venues, including a rooftop bar with panoramic sea view, a rooftop pool, and a fitness center.


### Coco De Mer Maldives, Tapestry Collection by Hilton


**Maldives**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** Q2 2027
